import itertools
fac={}
for bn,b in [('t',t),('x',x),('v',v)]:
    for p in [-2,-1,-0.75,-0.5,-0.25,0.25,0.5,0.75,1,1.5,2,3]:
        fac[f'{bn}^{p}']=(bn,b**p)
    fac[f'cos({bn})']=(bn,np.cos(b)); fac[f'sin({bn})']=(bn,np.sin(b))
    fac[f'exp(-{bn})']=(bn,np.exp(-b)); fac[f'exp({bn})']=(bn,np.exp(b))
    fac[f'log({bn})']=(bn,np.log(b))
fac['const']=('c',np.ones_like(t))
s=np.sqrt(v)
Y=dv_dt; vy=np.var(Y)
keys=list(fac)
cols={}
# products of different-input factors, plus singles
for k in keys:
    cols[k]=fac[k][1]
for k1,k2 in itertools.combinations(keys,2):
    if fac[k1][0]==fac[k2][0] or fac[k1][0]=='c' or fac[k2][0]=='c': continue
    cols[f'{k1}*{k2}']=fac[k1][1]*fac[k2][1]
ck=list(cols); M=np.column_stack([cols[k] for k in ck])
print(len(ck))
best=[]
# base: s, const ; add one product P and one single Q (from cols) -> loop P over all, Q over singles
singles=[k for k in ck if '*' not in k]
for i,kp in enumerate(ck):
    if '*' not in kp: continue
    for kq in singles:
        A=np.column_stack([s,M[:,i],cols[kq],np.ones_like(t)]) if kq!='const' else np.column_stack([s,M[:,i],np.ones_like(t)])
        c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,Y,rcond=None)
        r=np.mean((A@c-Y)**2)/vy
        if r<0.005: best.append((round(r,6),kp,kq,c.round(3)))
best.sort(key=lambda z:z[0])
print(len(best))
for b in best[:15]: print(b)
